_comment: Canonical vocabulary for routing-policy.yaml `when` clauses and `decision`s. Single source of truth shared by the compiler (policy-compiler/compile.py), the CLI (policyctl.py), the web editor (tools/policy-editor) and schema validation. Metadata (label/description/signals/value) drives the authoring UIs; `render` selects the compiler's OTTL renderer (kept in Python because exact OTTL is correctness-critical). Adding a NEW condition primitive = add an entry here + implement its `render` in compile.py (a fase-2 extension point).

families.error_or_slo: Error / SLO-relevant signal (any signal type). Used positively by an upgrade rule and negatively by a safe-downgrade rule. The full per-signal family predicate is reused so a downgrade never touches an error/SLO signal, even for signal types the downgrade rule did not explicitly list.

compliance_hold.label: Compliance hold
compliance_hold.description: Service is under legal/audit retention (from the service catalog). Never dropped.

service_tier.label: Service criticality tier
service_tier.description: Match one or more criticality tiers from the service catalog.

log_severity.label: Log severity at or above
log_severity.description: Threshold semantics: matches records whose severity is at or above the LOWEST severity in the list (OTel severity_number ordering). Log signals only.

span_status.label: Span status code
span_status.description: Match a span status code (OTTL STATUS_CODE_*). Span signals only.

http_status_gte.label: HTTP status code >=
http_status_gte.description: Match spans whose http.status_code is at or above this value (e.g. 500 for server errors). Span signals only.

metric_is_slo_relevant.label: Metric is SLO-relevant
metric_is_slo_relevant.description: Match metrics whose name looks SLO-relevant (latency/error-rate/request-count). Metric signals only.

env.label: Deployment environment
env.description: Match one or more values of the resource attribute deployment.environment (e.g. prod, staging).

region.label: Cloud region
region.description: Match one or more values of the resource attribute cloud.region (e.g. us-east-1).

metric_name_matches.label: Metric name matches (regex)
metric_name_matches.description: Match metrics whose name matches this RE2 regular expression. Metric signals only.

http_route_matches.label: HTTP route matches (regex)
http_route_matches.description: Match spans whose http.route attribute matches this RE2 regular expression (e.g. ^/healthz$). Span signals only.

over_budget.label: Service is over budget
over_budget.description: Resolved at compile time from Prometheus (policy:over_budget:by_service). Expands to the set of over-budget services. Used by the budget circuit-breaker downgrade rule.

log_severity_not_in.label: Log severity NOT in
log_severity_not_in.description: Negates the error/SLO family for the signal (safe-downgrade guard). Documented as excluding the FULL error/SLO family, not only log severity.

span_status_not.label: Span status NOT
span_status_not.description: Negates the error/SLO family for the signal (safe-downgrade guard). Documented as excluding the FULL error/SLO family, not only span status.
